prompt:
A production-ready inventory atlas for a charming Ming-inspired wuxia game: square canvas, EXACT invisible 4x4 equal-cell grid, 16 distinct isolated icons. CRITICAL LAYOUT: SMALL OBJECTS with maximum width and height each only 55% of its cell, at least 22% transparent margin on every side of every cell. Centers exactly x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of canvas. All silhouettes complete and disconnected, never cross cell boundaries. Lots of empty transparent space. Fully transparent background. No labels, writing, letters, numbers, grid, frame, border, watermark, or glow. Cohesive hand painted watercolor/gouache texture, fine warm brown outlines, rounded tactile forms, warm ivory/jade/coral and natural material palette, gentle top-left light, slight three-quarter overhead view. Only specified objects, row-major left to right top to bottom:
1. Compact square iron hammer head on a short worn brown wooden handle.
2. Slender silver gray metal file with crosshatched teeth and oval wooden grip.
3. Yellow bamboo handled carving knife with short triangular blade and slim brown sheath.
4. Ochre wooden bow saw frame, thin steel blade, twisted hemp tension cord.
5. Broad pale wooden clamp with a brass pivot and gray cloth padded jaws.
6. Round gray ceramic mortar and stubby pestle with traces of ochre pigment.
7. Delicate brass balance rod with round pan, tiny sliding weight and navy sleeve.
8. Open slim bamboo needle case, needles tucked in rust cloth, white thread around exterior.
9. Short broad gray splitting blade with flat brown handle and two bamboo strips.
10. Short pointed dark iron awl with pear shaped brown wooden handle.
11. Dark gray rectangular whetstone in a light brown sliding wooden case.
12. Wide flat cream bristle brush with dark bamboo handle and burgundy binding.
13. Short open brass pliers with dark brown leather pads on both jaws.
14. Compact bamboo and wood marking reel, round axle, pull ring and a short black cord.
15. Dark chestnut lacquer tray with six compartments holding a few brass pins and wood chips.
16. Half unrolled olive brown canvas tool roll showing a small hammer, file and wooden ruler.
visual_review: All 16 workshop tools appear in correct row-major order. Entire silhouettes visible and visually separated; no text or grid present. Some item bundles contain expected companion parts (knife sheath, bamboo strips, needles). Actual occupancy exceeds requested 55%, so crop using measured regions if needed. Alpha transparency and nonempty cells verified; low-alpha watercolor flecks remain.
